Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 6
Reason for Mistake: WebSurfer misinterpreted the USGS content by overemphasizing back-arc extension and concluded that rift zones (D) “align best,” contradicting the primary and well-established cause of Mount St. Helens volcanism: subduction at a convergent boundary (Juan de Fuca plate beneath the North American plate). This incorrect mapping led toward the wrong option instead of the correct A) converging boundaries.
